attributes.name: Caizarlu Zerren
attributes.powers:
Before the encounter, each character at this location must summon and encounter a Zombie Minion henchman.

When you attempt a check to defeat Caizarlu Zerren, after you make the roll, roll 1d6. On a 1 or 2, start the check over. Cards played on the previous check do not affect the new check.

All damage dealt by Caizarlu Zerren is Poison damage.
